title: Speculative Hook/Plugin Systems (Premature Extensibility)
pattern: Defining plugin frameworks or generic callback systems before there is a concrete need for more than one hardcoded implementation.
why_bad: Incurs high design debt and cognitive overhead for an integration point that may never be built, or will have completely different requirements.
detection: Generics or closure registrations with zero concrete registrants or only one trivial test double.
counterexample: Frameworks designed specifically for external pluggability.
fix: Replace the hook/plugin mechanism with a direct concrete call.
source: Titus Winters et al., *Software Engineering at Google* (2020); Fowler, *Refactoring*, Chapter 3.
